stays.headline: Cosme, the best beach stay on Paros
paras: Cosme is my pick for a beach stay on Paros. The base rooms are bigger than many hotels' junior suites, the private beach club sits right in front of the hotel, and the circular spa and gym are some of the most interesting buildings on the island.
Between the beach, the spa and the restaurants you could happily stay put, and Naoussa is a short walk for dinner.

img.caption: Nos, above the fishing village of Faros

stays.headline: Nos, the island where Greece slows down
paras: Nos is one of my favorite stays in the Cyclades. Minimalist Cycladic architecture above the fishing village of Faros, sweeping Aegean views and a pace that matches Sifnos exactly.
Sifnos is the cooking island: pottery villages along a ridge, the best tavernas in the Cyclades for an island its size, and in May it is green and walkable.

img.caption: Canaves Oia Suites, high on the caldera in Oia

stays.headline: Canaves Oia Suites, the classic caldera finale
paras: This was the best hotel I saw for honeymooners on Santorini. A full renovation brought beautiful finishes everywhere, and it sits higher on the caldera than most, so it is noticeably more private than the rest of Oia.
After eight quiet nights you have earned the postcard: the sunset from your own terrace, and Oia's lanes a short walk away.
